title: exu.HT: the functions of the accepted proposal, with examples in its documentation and tests
author: Claude-JG
description: Realization of the HT proposal: the bindings on the existing C++ conversions, examples in the data structures section (rotation, position, the node coordinates), a test model.
releaseNotes: exu.HT converts from and to Euler parameters, Tait-Bryan angles, rotation vector and the coordinates of the rigid body nodes, gives Relative, InterpolateSO3, InterpolateSE3, RotationAngle and RotationAxis; its Set functions return it
